excerpt: From Intern to Employee: Designing Internship Programs That Lead to Full-Time Employment Published by: Can X Global Solutions Inc. In today’s competitive labor market, retaining skilled and reliable farm workers is more challenging than ever. With seasonal demands, rural job locations, and physically demanding work, the agricultural sector often faces high turnover rates. If you’re wondering how to retain agricultural workers and build a stable, long-term workforce, you’re not alone. Farmers and agribusinesses across Canada are seeking effective strategies to keep their workers motivated, loyal, and returning season after season.
